model_annotation: The graph displays three lines representing different economic and political indices over time, with the x-axis showing years from 2016 to 2024 and two y-axes labeled "Index" on the left and right sides. The left y-axis ranges from 0 to 1000 in increments of 100, while the right y-axis ranges from 0 to 9000 in increments of 1000. The graph compares the trends of "Wirtschaftspolitik insgesamt" (black line, left scale), "Finanzpolitik" (blue line, left scale), and "Handelspolitik" (purple line, right scale). The black line starts at around 50 in 2016, peaks at approximately 600 in 2021, drops to around 100 in 2023, and then rises to about 500 by 2024. The blue line begins at roughly 100 in 2016, reaches a peak of around 450 in 2021, declines to approximately 200 in 2023, and increases to about 8000 by 2024. The purple line starts near 0 in 2016, surges to around 7000 in 2021, falls to nearly 0 in 2023, and then sharply rises to approximately 8000 by 2024.
